title: Set 141

sentences.ko: 그러니까, 그냥 말해 버릴까 싶기도 한데, 말했다가 그 사람이 오해라도 하면 앞으로 가족끼리 밥 먹을 때마다 어색해질 거잖아. 그래서 모르겠어. 너라면 어떻게 할 것 같아?
sentences.text: I mean, part of me thinks I should just tell him, but if I do and he takes it the wrong way, it's going to be weird at every family dinner from now on. So I don't know. What would you do?

alts.text: Honestly, I kinda wanna just tell him, you know? But if he takes it wrong, every family dinner's gonna be weird forever. I dunno. What would you do?

Part of me believes I ought to simply tell him; however, if I do and he misunderstands, every family dinner from now on will be uncomfortable. I am not certain what to do. What would you do in my position?

sentences.note: **part of me** 는 마음 한편으로는 이라는 뜻으로, 마음이 반반일 때 씁니다. **takes it the wrong way** 는 말을 오해해서 기분 나쁘게 받아들인다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구한테 고민 상담하면서 결론은 못 내리기

sentences.ko: 야, 너 벌써 한 여섯 개는 싫다고 했거든? 그러니까 지금 당장 하나 고르든가, 아니면 다음에 뜨는 거 그냥 볼 거야. 자막 있어도 난 상관 안 해.
sentences.text: Okay, you've said no to like six things already, so either you pick something right now or we're watching whatever comes up next, and I don't care if it has subtitles.

alts.text: You've shot down like six things already. Pick one now or we're watching whatever's next, and I don't care if it's got subtitles.
You have already declined approximately six options, so either you choose something now or we will watch whatever appears next, and I do not mind if it has subtitles.

sentences.note: **said no to** 는 거절했다는 뜻인데, casual 문장의 **shot down** 도 제안을 퇴짜 놓는다는 말로 자주 씁니다. **like six** 의 like 는 한 여섯 개쯤처럼 대충 말할 때 붙입니다.

sentences.ko: 그 사람은 내 오타 지적하려고 계속 전체 답장을 눌러. 내 상사도 아닌데 말이야. 그러니까 내가 뭐라고 하면 괜히 나만 일을 크게 만드는 사람처럼 보일까 봐 말도 못 하겠어.
sentences.text: He keeps hitting reply all just to point out my typos, and he's not even my boss, so I can't really say anything without looking like I'm the one making a big deal out of it.

alts.text: The guy keeps replying all just to call out my typos, and he's not even my boss. If I say anything, I'm the one making it a thing.
He repeatedly replies to everyone solely to point out my typographical errors, and he is not my supervisor, so I cannot say anything without appearing to be the one exaggerating the matter.

sentences.note: **reply all** 은 메일의 전체 답장입니다. **making a big deal out of it** 은 별일 아닌 걸 크게 만든다, 유난 떤다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 회사 사람 때문에 짜증난 걸 친구한테 털어놓기

sentences.ko: 딸이 책 하나만 더 읽어 달라고 하더니, 물 달라고 하고, 그다음엔 엄청 중요한 할 말이 있다는 거야. 알고 보니 공원에서 본 강아지 얘기였어. 겨우 잠들었을 때는 나도 너무 지쳐서 TV 켤 힘도 없더라.
sentences.text: She wanted one more story, then some water, then she had to tell me something really important, which turned out to be about a dog she saw at the park. By the time she finally fell asleep, I was too tired to even turn on the TV.

alts.text: One more story, then water, then something super important, which was about some dog she saw at the park. When she finally fell asleep, I was too wiped to even turn on the TV.

She asked for one more story, then some water, and then said she had something very important to tell me, which turned out to concern a dog she had seen at the park. By the time she finally fell asleep, I was too exhausted even to turn on the television.

sentences.note: **turned out to be** 는 알고 보니 ~였다는 뜻입니다. **By the time** 은 ~할 때쯤에는 이라는 뜻으로, 그때 이미 어떤 상태였는지 말할 때 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 별거 아니었어, 진짜로. 의사가 그 상자들 다 옮기다가 근육이 좀 늘어난 것 같대. 그래서 2주 정도는 무리하지 말래. 솔직히 나쁘지 않아.
sentences.text: It was nothing, really. The doctor said it's probably just a pulled muscle from carrying all those boxes, so I have to take it easy for a couple of weeks, which, honestly, I'm not complaining about.

alts.text: Nah, it's nothing. Doc says it's probably just a pulled muscle from hauling all those boxes, so I gotta take it easy for a couple weeks. Honestly? Not complaining.
It was nothing serious. The doctor said it is most likely a pulled muscle from carrying all of those boxes, so I must rest for a couple of weeks, which, to be honest, I do not mind at all.

sentences.note: **pulled muscle** 은 근육이 결리거나 살짝 늘어난 것을 말합니다. **take it easy** 는 무리하지 않고 쉬엄쉬엄 한다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 병원 갔다 온 얘기 가볍게 하기

reviewed: 1번 casual 이 text 와 똑같이 part of me 로 시작해서, 첫머리를 바꾸고 더 짧은 구어로 고침
3번 casual 의 doing reply all 은 원어민이 안 쓰는 말이라 replying all 로 고침. making it a big thing 도 어색해서 making it a thing 으로 고침. text 와 똑같이 He keeps 로 시작하던 첫머리도 바꿈
5번 한국어의 근육이 놀란 것 같대 는 pulled muscle 의 뜻과 조금 달라서 근육이 좀 늘어난 것 같대 로 고침
